response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneref, t.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize::double precision / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM grp;

assumptions.assumption: chronotag is compared as text, as the request specifies, so BETWEEN is a lexicographic range check; the schema types chronotag as text(6) while the documentation describes it as a timestamp, so the text range may not match the intended date range.
'Linked to a site by site code' means scans.zoneref matches sites.zoneregistry (inner join), so scans with no matching site are excluded.
Rows with spanmin = 0 are treated as missing for the size-per-minute value (NULLIF prevents division-by-zero errors), and NULL values are ignored by AVG.
Groups with a NULL typesite are kept as their own group, and the bounds of the chronotag range are inclusive.
